q: Which solution supports end-to-end line-rate encryption between two sites?

IPsec is typically used at Layer 3 and may introduce overhead. GRE does not provide encryption. TrustSec uses tagging and policy enforcement, not line-rate encryption.

o.C: GCMP128 encryption with OWE key management

This configuration ensures a secure, passphrase-based connection that complies with WPA3 standards. 802.1X is used for WPA3-Enterprise, not passphrase-based access. OWE is for open networks with encryption but no authentication. CCKM is used for fast secure roaming, not for WPA3.

The authentication server (e.g., RADIUS) validates the credentials. NAC (Network Access Control) is a broader concept and not a direct role in 802.1X.

q: Which device sends an SNonce during a four-way handshake exchange when using an SSID configured with WPA2-Enterprise?

o.D: AP
